iterations.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a polished high fidelity Chinese portrait mobile game UI design board for the existing WeChat village tower-defense game 代代守村. Landscape presentation board, ideally 1536x1024 or wider, three clear columns, each a tall vertical screen/panel. This is a design proposal, NOT a screenshot. Use image 1 solely for the already approved bright pastoral UI palette and material quality: deep forest-green header, fresh leaf-green inset, warm ivory cream cards with thin wheat-gold borders, honey wood edges, subtle beveled green action buttons, orange-red close button top RIGHT. Use image 2 for the current game scene and UI proportions, enlarged soft 3D-rendered-into-2D village art, lush forest borders, curved dirt road and towers, compact top HUD and round central battle button. Keep the scene recognizably the same. Very sharp typography and icons, excellent optical alignment, legible large type, restrained ornament, consistent spacing. Never place icons or text onto card outlines.
Board top title exact: "代代守村 · 战技系统". Top subtitle exact: "界面草案｜待定战技仅作状态演示".
LEFT COLUMN titled "入口位置": show current game's main screen with compact centered game title at top, main map dominant, and round central 开始守夜 button below. At the far left of the forest strip, add a compact stack of TWO matched vertical cream-and-gold badges: top trophy icon and text "排行", directly beneath an open scroll icon and text "战技". Make the icon and text centered within each badge, icons visually about 40% of badge height. Do NOT cover the road, enemies, or first tower. Use narrower badge widths if needed to stay in the left forest strip. Above map HUD keep "代代守村", "第1年 · 春2日", resource line "粮 60/200", "木 80/200", "人 6/8". Keep original map visible, no skill inventory overlay here. Bottom four village buttons and center round 开始守夜.
CENTER COLUMN titled "战技列表": polished full-height green panel titled "守村战技", close X top right, no decorative wheat on left. Resource strip "已守 6 波" "木 80" "粮 60". One line "每夜携带 1 个 · 使用 1 次". Three clearly separated ivory cards, ample readable font. Card1 heart-with-small-crown icon, name "大王之心", text "全塔攻速 +50% · 持续15秒", golden status pill "已携带". Card2 neutral rolled-scroll icon (NOT any specific magical ability), name "待定战技 A", small annotation "效果待定", condition "已守 6/3 波", costs "木 80/40  粮 60/10", green action button "学习并携带". Card3 grey-green card with neutral locked-scroll icon, name "待定战技 B", condition "已守 6/9 波", disabled button "还需 3 波". All count/price values are visual examples. Under cards tiny explanatory line "示例条件与价格，非最终配置". Cards must not overlap their buttons. No final skills like arrows, lightning, shields or ice.
RIGHT COLUMN titled "学习详情": show centered moderately sized detail panel (not unnecessarily tall) on subtly dimmed pastoral background. Title "战技详情", small back arrow top left, X top right. Neutral scroll icon, centered name "待定战技 A", subtitle "名称与效果由你确定". Cream inset containing clear lines "学习条件  已守6/3波", "学习消耗  木40 · 粮10", "当前拥有  木80 · 粮60", "学习后剩余  木40 · 粮50". Large green bottom button "学习并携带". Under button short note "学会后免费更换". Do not show a real unapproved skill effect.
Art quality must match the bright approved UI reference. Avoid flat wireframes, pixel art, dark fantasy, excessive sparkles, particles, tiny illegible text, extra currency, skill levels, buy gems, prices in real money, watermarks, smartphone hardware bezels. No blank massive panel areas. Board margins clean light cream. Clearly distinguish illustrative placeholder skills from real 大王之心. Render Chinese text exactly and very legibly. Keep all action buttons fully inside the panel edges.

iterations.purpose: 统一白天状态、底部导航与锁定标记
iterations.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / ui-mockup. Refine this exact UI design board. Preserve the central skill list, the right learning detail, all excellent cream/gold/green materials, Chinese typography, dimensions, icon alignment, spacing and the large overall title. Preserve the left map's tower, trees, buildings and narrow left stack of 排行 and 战技 badges. Correct only these issues:
1. The LEFT example must consistently be DAYTIME before battle, NOT paused nighttime. Change its date text to "第1年 · 秋1日". Change the green map status line to "第7天 · 今夜8名来敌 · 已守6波". Remove the visible enemy figures on the OUTSIDE road only, leaving towers, road and scenery intact and keeping village villagers.
2. Replace the LEFT example bottom "已暂停 · 场上1 · 待来7" line with "产粮20 · 口粮12 · 产木14".
3. Replace LEFT example bottom pause/speed controls with the current DAY layout: a large round green center "开始守夜" button, two small cream/gold icon buttons on each side. Left two labels "村民" and "家庭", right two "建设" and "家谱". Icons above captions, adequate padding, matching current game's four navigation controls. No "暂停", "速度", or heart ability text in this daytime footer. Round button icon can be a simple golden shield, not crowned heart.
4. In the CENTER bottom locked grey-green card "待定战技 B", replace the CHECKMARK before "已守6/9波" with a small LOCK symbol, because the condition is not met. Keep "还需3波".
5. Existing central/right prices are illustrative only; preserve "界面草案｜待定战技仅作状态演示" and "示例条件与价格，非最终配置".
No other changes. Make the whole board pristine, high resolution and genuinely readable. Do not add new skills or effects.

constraints: 图稿中 A/B 仅为状态占位，正式目录只有现有大王之心
图中 3/9 波及 40 木/10 粮不是已确认价格
入口在排行下方，正式短屏与塔遮挡尚待实绘验证
设计图不参与资源构建，不可作为真机效果证据
